contract.images: Explicit bounded grayscale/RGB bytes, process/view ownership, ordered capture replies consumed once; valid PNG/BMP export without live camera access
contract.finds: Matching image-bound completed batches or inline line completions; active results/parameters shared with core service, no image algorithm
contract.outputs: Stage complete PATH/header/node data before replacing; reader register/file transfer preserves length on failure; disjoint exact references and budgets remain
contract.files: Whole replacement through exact bounded file backends, explicit rooted filesystem, busy/quota/path checks, atomic disk writes and obsolete virtual bytes
contract.devices: Explicit power observations, matching calibration replies, headless selected tool and one logical LED; no acquired native state
contract.persistence: Pixels, remaining capture/calibration replies, reader/line batches and logical state only

discrepancies.manual: Syntax lists value/not_zip; parameter table lists output_path and three parameters; newer edition adds iPC while leaving not_zip undocumented
discrepancies.decision: Support the three-parameter Pythonic operation from the parameter table; reject extra unexplained/iPC arguments

boundaries: No native acquisition/calibration computation, pixel/edge processing, camera format inference, hardware LED effects or native graphics
PNG/BMP encode supplied 8-bit grayscale/RGB only; no alpha/palettes/depth maps, native image metadata, iPC routing or compression-option inference
Synchronous completed replies and portable statuses do not establish native timing, ABI, controller acceptance or strict equivalence
